bundle.longDescription: Native desktop shell for the PointSav sovereign GIS tile viewer. Renders a locally-vendored MapLibre GL map against a configurable tile-source endpoint (gis.woodfinegroup.com or a PPN/WireGuard address) inside a native macOS window.

security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https: http: ; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-eval' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https: http: ; worker-src 'self' blob: ; font-src 'self' data:

_notes.tauri-version: v1.x — required for macOS 10.13 High Sierra. Upgrade to v2 when dev machine targets macOS 10.15+.
_notes.maplibre: MapLibre GL JS 4.7.1 (BSD-3-Clause) vendored locally at src/vendor/maplibre-gl/ — no CDN reference, works offline/air-gapped.
_notes.csp: connect-src/img-src allow both https: and http: broadly because the tile endpoint is operator-configurable at runtime (public HTTPS host or a bare-IP PPN/WireGuard address) — narrow to the specific configured host once the endpoint is fixed in a given deployment.
_notes.icons: Copy icons from app-workplace-memo/src-tauri/icons/ before first macOS build.
